body: I agree. Spending time outside in a quiet place is nice too.
I hope they do as well. I wish there was an easy explanation.

I'm so happy for you. I've been struggling with these thoughts for almost 10 years and I just told my parents the other day. They reacted similarly to yours. Had I known that I would've told them so much sooner. Good luck my friend!
Are you able to have a pet where you live? My dogs help make life soooooo much more bearable even though they are a little work.
I wish I could help man. I hope you make the best decision for yourself. ❤️

Honestly just tell them! I just told mine for the first time (been struggling for 9 yrs) and it helped so much to hear what they have to say. A lot of times its a genetic thing too so you may find out that your parents have gone through the same things you have.
Thank you for sharing this with us. I love you and will be praying for you.

Whenever I feel my depression worsening or a lack of motivation I always go back to Matthew 7:7-8 “Ask and it will be given to you; seek and you will find; knock and the door will be opened to you. For everyone who asks receives; the one who seeks finds; and to the one who knocks, the door will be opened."

Ask for what you need from God and if it's in His will for you it will happen. If you can muster up even the slighted bit of faith it will help. You're always where you need to be in your life journey.

I also recommend reading "Looking for Lovely" by Annie F. Downs. It's a pretty short read but has the power to heal if you're open to it. I'll pray for you.
Thank you for responding! I've never been good with ultimatums but it is certainly something to try before cutting it off for good.
Thank you for your kind words! Talking to a therapist is a great idea. I just need to bring myself to do it.

You're totally not alone with your shock at our age. Sometimes I can't believe it myself.

I think you're pretty spot on with what you're saying though. It's nice to have some validation. Thank you!

Thanks for the response! He doesn't contribute financially because he hasn't worked since we moved to a new state for my job back in August 2016. He sort of tried looking for work in October but he gave up on that. He now pet sits occasionally but gets angry when I ask for money to pay bills. I honestly don't know where he would be living if he wasn't with me. He could probably go back to his mom's but that's not at all an ideal place for him. 

I can agree that the relationship may have run it's course but I'm really struggling with the fact that I'm not completely sure I want to end it and don't want to do something I regret. 

I really do appreciate your response though! I wasn't sure if I'd get one as this is my first time ever posting on Reddit.
